title: Executive Assistant To Director
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder & Director Company: WebBee
Location: Noida, Sector 62
Employment Type: Full-Time, In-Office
Working Days: 5.5 Days per Week 
 About WebBee WebBee is a fast-growing SaaS and eCommerce technology company helping global businesses automate operations through integrations, ERP connectivity, and scalable commerce solutions. We work extensively with platforms like NetSuite, Shopify, Amazon, ShipStation, and other modern SaaS ecosystems. As we continue to scale our products and global operations, we are looking for an experienced, mature, and trustworthy Executive Assistant to work directly with the Founder & Director. 
 Position Summary We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant who can act as an operational extension of the Founder, manage multiple priorities, coordinate across departments, and ensure that meetings and decisions translate into timely execution. The ideal candidate will demonstrate professional maturity, discretion, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced technology and services environment. Female candidates are preferred for this position. Women returning to work after a career break are also encouraged to apply. 

 Key Requirements (Must-Have) Experience: Minimum 6 years of relevant experience as an Executive Assistant to a Founder, CEO, MD, Director, or senior leadership. Candidate Preference: Female candidates are preferred for this position. Career Returners: Women returning to work after a career break are encouraged to apply, provided they meet the role's experience and skill requirements. Industry Experience: Proven experience in IT services, SaaS, software services, consulting, or a similar client-facing services business. Executive Support: Experience managing executive calendars, meetings, priorities, follow-ups, and confidential communications. Multitasking: Ability to handle multiple priorities and tight deadlines without compromising accuracy. Professional Maturity: Calm, composed, discreet, and capable of exercising sound judgment when dealing with senior leadership, clients, and partners. Confidentiality: High integrity when handling sensitive business and employee information. Communication:Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Education:Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or a business/operations background is preferred. 

 Key Responsibilities 1. Founder & Executive Support Manage the Founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities. Coordinate internal and external meetings. Prepare meeting agendas and Minutes of Meeting (MOMs). Track action items and follow up with stakeholders until closure. Filter and prioritize communications for the Founder. Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. 2. Business Coordination & Execution Coordinate across Product, Sales, Marketing, HR, and Operations. Track project timelines, deliverables, and pending actions. Maintain dashboards, trackers, and reports for leadership reviews. Ensure alignment between leadership decisions and departmental execution. Assist with strategic initiatives and special projects. 3. Administrative & Operational Support Manage travel planning, itineraries, bookings, and logistics. Handle vendor coordination and office administration. Organize documents, reports, presentations, and business records. Support events, webinars, leadership meetings, and client visits. Ensure the smooth day-to-day functioning of the Founder's Office. 4. Communication & Documentation Draft professional emails, presentations, reports, and internal communications. Maintain meeting records and business documentation. Coordinate professionally with clients, partners, and leadership teams. Prepare executive summaries, status reports, and briefing notes. 

 Tools & Technology Candidates should be comfortable using, or willing to learn, the following tools: Google Workspace Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint ChatGPT and other AI productivity tools 

 Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be: Disciplined, highly responsive, and dependable. Proactive, execution-oriented, and accountable. Strong at follow-through and anticipating potential issues. Calm and composed under pressure. Capable of working independently without constant supervision. Comfortable managing sensitive information and executive priorities. Effective at coordinating people, projects, and deadlines across departments. 

 Work Details Location: Noida, Sector 62 Work Arrangement: Full-Time, In-Office Working Days: 5.5 days per week Preferred Location: Noida and Delhi NCR Joining Preference: Immediate joiners preferred 

 Compensation & Career Growth Competitive salary based on experience and capability. Direct exposure to Founder-level decision-making and business operations. Opportunities to contribute to strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects. Potential career growth into Founder's Office, Business Operations, or Operations Leadership. 

 Why Join WebBee? Work directly with the Founder on strategic and operational initiatives. Learn how a global SaaS and eCommerce technology business scales. Gain exposure to Product, Technology, Sales, HR, Operations, and leadership execution. Work in a fast-growing environment with opportunities for professional development. 

 Special Encouragement for Women Returning to Work Women professionals who are planning to restart their careers after a break are encouraged to apply. Candidates with the relevant Executive Assistant experience, professional maturity, organizational skills, and ability to manage executive responsibilities are welcome to explore this opportunity. WebBee welcomes applications from qualified professionals and is committed to equal opportunity in recruitment.

title: Deputy Unit Manager - IA HR
description:
To design and drive contemporary people and engagement interventions that build a future ready workforce, working as an individual contributor who conceptualises, curates and delivers initiatives end to end for the assigned business. To continuously map industry wide best practices in talent management and employee engagement, adapt them to the organisation's context and culture, and implement them seamlessly through platforms such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons and other new age interventions. To strengthen employee experience, pride, capability and connect so that talent stays engaged, future skilled and aligned to the organisation's growth agenda. Responsibilities Designing and Driving People Initiatives for a Future Ready Workforce. Act as an individual contributor Engagement Partner who conceptualises, designs and drives the annual people engagement and talent management calendar for the assigned business. Build a deep understanding of the business agenda, workforce profile, capability gaps, culture priorities and employee sentiment to shape interventions that create a future ready workforce. Own the initiative lifecycle end to end - idea, design, stakeholder alignment, budget, communication, rollout, participation and post event impact measurement. Translate business and HR priorities into simple, scalable and repeatable people programs that can be run across locations and employee segments. Industry Best Practice Mapping and Adaptation. Continuously scan and benchmark industry wide best practices in engagement, talent management, employee experience, learning and future skilling across peer organisations, technology firms and start ups. Adapt and contextualise external best practices to the organisation's culture, employee demographics, business rhythm and cost discipline rather than adopting them as is. Pilot new ideas with defined success criteria, gather feedback, refine and scale the ones that work, while retiring interventions that do not add value. Ensure seamless implementation by building clear process documents, toolkits, communication assets and manager enablement material for every intervention. Flagship Engagement Platforms - Townhalls, Summits and People Connects. Plan and execute leadership townhalls including theme, content flow, leadership messaging, employee QA, logistics, attendance and post event feedback. Design and anchor summits and forums that showcase business achievements, innovation stories, customer impact and future roadmap for the workforce. Drive structured people connects such as skip level connects, new joiner connects, women connects, high potential connects, focus groups and pulse conversations to capture employee voice. Convert insights from connects, pulse surveys and culture surveys into clear action plans and follow through to closure with business and HR stakeholders. Career, Capability and Innovation Interventions. Design and run career workshops, career conversation frameworks, role based growth paths, internal mobility drives and mentoring circles that help employees see and build their future in the organisation. Conceptualise and deliver hackathons, ideathons, innovation challenges and learning sprints that build new age skills, encourage original thinking and create visible ownership. Partner with LD and business experts to curate future skilling journeys, certification drives, tech talks, knowledge sharing sessions and communities of practice. Strengthen rewards and recognition, onboarding and buddy programs, milestone celebrations and other employee experience moments that matter. Communication, Measurement and Governance. Build the internal communication narrative for people initiatives through bulletins, mailers, digital channels, leadership messages and campaign creatives. Define and track measurable outcomes for every intervention - participation, reach, feedback scores, engagement and culture survey movement, capability build and retention impact. Publish dashboards and review decks for leadership covering engagement calendar progress, action closures, employee sentiment themes and best practice adoption. Manage budgets, vendors and event partners with cost discipline, timelines and quality standards. The principal accountabilities of the role holder are expected to impact the organization from two perspectives: A. Business Indicators Timely and seamless execution of the annual engagement and talent management calendar Improvement in engagement, ESAT and culture survey scores for the assigned business Number of industry best practices mapped, piloted and successfully scaled within the organisation Participation, reach and feedback scores across townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons Reduction in regrettable attrition and improvement in internal mobility and future skill readiness Adherence to budget, timelines and closure of actions arising from employee feedback B. Employees and Stakeholders Stronger employee connect, voice and sense of belonging across levels and locations Greater clarity on career paths, growth opportunities and skills required for the future Visible platforms for innovation, original thinking and recognition of contribution Higher pride in the organisation, the work and the leadership connect Enabled managers who can carry engagement and career conversations forward with their teams Key Decisions / Dimensions Design, theme, format and calendar of engagement and talent management interventions for the assigned business. Selection of industry best practices to be benchmarked, piloted, scaled or discontinued basis relevance and impact. Content flow, agenda and employee communication approach for townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops and hackathons. Recommendation on vendors, event partners, platforms and budget utilisation within approved limits. Identification of engagement hotspots, employee sentiment themes and the corrective action priorities to be taken up with business leaders. Metrics, feedback mechanisms and closure timelines to be used for measuring the success of each intervention. Major Challenges Establishing credibility as an individual contributor who designs and delivers large scale people initiatives without a direct team, relying purely on influence and stakeholder partnership. Adapting industry best practices to the organisation's context, culture and cost structure so that they land meaningfully instead of being seen as borrowed ideas. Keeping interventions fresh and relevant for a diverse and multi generational workforce spread across levels, locations and work models. Securing leadership time, manager participation and employee bandwidth for townhalls, summits, workshops and hackathons amidst demanding business timelines. Demonstrating measurable business and people impact of engagement interventions rather than event level participation alone. Balancing multiple concurrent initiatives, vendors and budgets while maintaining quality, timelines and a seamless employee experience. Required Qualifications and Experience a. Qualifications MBA / Post Graduate qualification in HR or related discipline preferred a. Work Experience 3 - 6 years of experience in employee engagement, talent management, employee experience, internal communication or HR partnering roles, preferably with exposure to technology or digital workforces. Demonstrated track record of independently designing and executing people initiatives such as townhalls, summits, people connects, career workshops, hackathons, recognition programs and culture campaigns. Ability to benchmark industry best practices, contextualise them to the organisation and implement them seamlessly end to end. Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling and communication skills with the ability to craft content for leadership and large employee audiences. Project and event management skills covering planning, budgeting, vendor management, logistics and timelines. Comfort with people analytics, survey data, dashboards and digital engagement platforms to measure impact and drive decisions. High ownership, creativity, stakeholder management and the ability to deliver as an individual contributor through influence.

title: Senior Saviynt IAM Engineer
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Saviynt IAM Engineer to lead the implementation, integration, and support of Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC/EICaaS) solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), identity lifecycle management, access certifications, role management, and access controls. This role will be responsible for designing and optimizing identity governance processes, integrating enterprise applications, and ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements. 
 Role: Senior Saviynt IAM Engineer Location: Pune Experience: 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Configure and manage access request workflows, role-based access controls, certifications, and attestation processes within Saviynt. Develop and customize connectors, workflows, rules, and provisioning processes to support business requirements. Design and support identity lifecycle management processes, including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows. Integrate Saviynt with enterprise platforms such as Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, Workday, ServiceNow, AWS, and other cloud applications. Implement and support Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security frameworks. Collaborate with Privileged Access Management (PAM) teams to enforce least privilege, Just-In-Time (JIT), and Just-Enough Access (JEA) principles. Perform access reviews, entitlement governance, segregation of duties (SoD) analysis, and compliance reporting activities. Monitor privileged accounts, identity risks, and access anomalies to strengthen security posture. Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Groovy, SQL, and other scripting technologies. Support API integrations using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, and related technologies. Manage IAM platform incidents, service requests, problem management, and change management activities. Support audit and compliance initiatives aligned with SOX, PCI-DSS, and other regulatory requirements. Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles. Collaborate with security, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams to implement IAM best practices. Participate in platform upgrades, enhancements, performance tuning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline. 8 to 12 years of overall IT experience with strong focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM). Minimum 5 years of hands-on IAM engineering experience. At least 3 years of experience implementing and supporting Saviynt IGA/EIC solutions. Strong expertise in identity governance concepts including access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, and access controls. Experience implementing Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes. Hands-on experience integrating Saviynt with cloud and enterprise applications. Strong understanding of Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, Workday, ServiceNow, and AWS integrations. Experience with authentication technologies including SSO, MFA, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and Zero Trust architectures. Knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM), access governance, and least privilege principles. Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Groovy, SQL, or equivalent technologies. Experience with API integration, REST/SOAP services, JSON, XML, and Postman. Familiarity with CI/CD practices and DevSecOps methodologies. Strong understanding of compliance frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and audit readiness requirements. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration abilities. Ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. Proactive mindset focused on process automation, optimization, and continuous improvement. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents 
 Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: 
 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. 
 We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
